justification: Inspected gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/LongSerializationPolicy.java and gson/src/test/java/com/google/gson/LongSerializationPolicyTest.java. The class is a very small enum with only 2 constants (DEFAULT, STRING) and 1 abstract method; each constant provides one short serialize implementation that only handles null plus number-vs-string formatting. There are no fields, helper methods, or multiple responsibilities, so the class is already cohesive and not insufficiently modularized.
